resources.string: Tap New to post an announcement.
Couldn\'t load announcements. Check your connection.
Add a title so people know what this is about.
Couldn\'t save. Check your connection, and that you\'re an admin.
One family in Christ. Sign in to share in our fellowship: updates, prayer, chat, the Word and more.
One family in Christ. Create your account to join our fellowship.
Password reset email sent. Check your inbox.
No connection. Check your internet and try again.
Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
That email and password don\'t match. Try again or create an account.
That email address doesn\'t look right.
An account with that email already exists. Try signing in.
Choose a password with at least 6 characters.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
Thank you for supporting our church.
Open Vipps and pay to this number.
Giving isn\'t set up yet. Use the pencil at the top to add your Vipps number and bank account.
Information about how to give will appear here soon.
This permanently removes your account and your profile. Announcements already posted stay. Enter your password to confirm.
We sent a verification link to %1$s. Open it, then come back here.
Please verify your email address to continue. We\'ll send a link to %1$s.
Not verified yet. Open the link in the email first, then try again.
Can\'t find it? Check your spam or junk folder.
Tap New sermon to add the first one.
Couldn\'t load sermons. Check your connection.
That doesn\'t look like a YouTube link.
The audio link must start with https://
That file is larger than 100 MB. Make it smaller and try again.
Please choose an audio file (MP3 or M4A).
Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
The sermon and its audio file will be removed.
Couldn\'t play the audio. Check your connection.
A church leader needs to approve your account before you can use chat. This helps keep our groups safe.
Create a group, or ask a leader to add you to one.
Couldn\'t create the group. Check your connection and try again.
Give the group a name (at least 2 letters).
Reported. An admin will look at it.
All messages in the group will be deleted for everyone.
Include the country code, for example +47… If you leave it out, +47 (Norway) is assumed.
Church leaders can use this to contact you and to confirm who you are. Admins can see it. Group leaders only see it if you choose to share it with their group.
That phone number doesn\'t look right.
Add your name and phone number so church leaders can recognise and reach you.
Share my phone number in this group
Choose who can see your number in this group. You can change this any time.
Add your phone number in your profile to share it.
Couldn\'t save the photo. Try a different picture or check your connection.
Your photo is visible to approved church members and admins.
Couldn\'t start the conversation. Try again.
They won\'t be able to send you private messages. You can unblock them any time.
They will be able to send you private messages again.
Members can send each other one-to-one messages. Switch off to stop all private messaging. Existing messages stay.
Private messages are switched off by an admin.
Couldn\'t load the list of members. Check your connection and try again.
No one else to add yet. Only people an admin has approved can be added.
No one else is approved yet. Approve people on the People screen first.
No approved members to add yet. Approve the people below, then pick them.
%1$s hasn\'t shared their number with you
No one else is approved yet.
Private messages are switched off for everyone.
No one has seen this yet.
Tap New event to add one.
Couldn\'t load events. Check your connection.
Share a request, and others can pray with you.
Other members won\'t see your name. Church leaders can.
Couldn\'t post your request. Check your connection, and that an admin has approved your account.
Couldn\'t load prayer requests. Check your connection, and that an admin has approved your account.
The phone allows notifications from this app
Notifications are switched on in the app
This phone is registered for chat notifications
If you can see this, notifications work on this phone.
To test the lock screen, send the test and then press the phone\'s power button.
No comments yet. Be the first to write one.
MP3 or M4A is best. Other audio files upload too, but may not play on every phone.
We are glad you are here.
Add your address, phone number and email with the pencil button.
Contact details will appear here soon.
Welcome! We would love to meet you. Come as you are. Ask any of our greeters if you need help, and find the service times and directions below.
There is nothing to sign up for yet.
Tap New to add a serving slot, for example Welcome team on Sunday.
The people who signed up will no longer see it.
Share an idea, a concern or some encouragement. It goes privately to the church leaders.
If you send without your name, the leaders cannot see who wrote it, so they cannot reply to you.
Thank you. Your message was sent to the leaders.
You won\'t get notifications from this conversation. New messages still show inside the app.
Link to the live video (YouTube or Facebook)
Enter a link that starts with https://
No internet connection. Showing what was saved on your phone.
Do you want to sign out?
Choose up to %1$d shortcuts for Home. Press and hold a shortcut to change them any time.
No notifications at night. Urgent announcements still come through.
Choose your language \u00B7 Velg spr\u00E5k \u00B7 Afaan kee filadhu
Home shows what is happening today. Church has announcements, events, sermons, serving and prayer. Press and hold a shortcut on Home to change it.
Talk in your church groups, send messages and photos, and react or reply to messages. Swipe a message to reply.
Sermons are in Church. Word has Bible links, studies and reading plans. More has giving, contact and service times, your notifications and settings.
A quick look at your church in the app. Only leaders can see this.
Choose a time in the future.
Open the People tab, choose someone and say hello.
Only approved members are listed here.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. \u2014 Psalm 23:1
Give each shortcut, Church section and More item its own colour. Switch off for one calm colour combination.
Allow the microphone to send voice messages.
Delete this? This cannot be undone.
Open the Afaan Oromoo Bible in another Bible app or website.
Leaders: add the link to your Afaan Oromoo Bible app or website.
Enter a link that starts with https://
Couldn\'t open this file. Install a PDF viewer app and try again.
%1$d file(s) could not be uploaded. PDF files up to 25 MB, audio up to 50 MB.
Delete this folder and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
Tap the microphone and speak. You can record up to two minutes.
Couldn\'t load your profile and permissions (%1$s). Leader tools and your name may be missing.
Checks that this phone can reach the church server. If something shows a cross, take a screenshot and send it to the person who built the app.
Leave your name and a way to reach you, and someone from the church will get in touch. Only the church leaders see what you write.
Add a phone number or an email so we can reach you.
Thank you! Someone from the church will contact you soon.
Couldn\'t send. Check your connection and try again.
Shown at the top of every page. Use a square picture, or a PNG with a see-through background.
Couldn\'t save the picture. Try another one.
Folders with lessons, PDF files, audio and voice notes. Open a folder to see what is inside.
Leaders: create a reading plan. Add one reading for each day.
Plan name (for example: Gospel of John)
One reading for each day, one per line
Delete this plan? Everyone\'s progress will no longer be shown.
Only you can see these. Tap Add time to mark where you are in the sermon.
Our YouTube channel is checked automatically. For a Facebook live, or any other link, paste it here and switch the banner on.
Lets people see when you have read their messages, and lets you see when they have read yours.
The colours chosen by the church leaders
Everyone who has not chosen their own colours will see these.
Event reminders (a day and an hour before)
Type at least two letters to search announcements, events, sermons and lessons.
Couldn\'t load the church content. Check your connection.
Today\'s reading, the next event and the verse of the day
Open the app once to fill this widget.
Stops at the end of this sermon
Everyone can read it, only leaders can post.
Only leaders can post in this channel.
Searches the messages loaded on this phone. Scroll up to load older ones.
Choose when it should be sent. It is sent even if the app is closed.
Choose a time in the future.
Nothing more is planned for this week. Tap This month to see what is coming.
Follow the church\'s Bible reading plan. Today\'s reading is on Home; tick it off there or in Word > Plans.
Open More and tap Search to find announcements, events, sermons and lessons.
A reminder a day and an hour before an event, and one tap to add it to your calendar.
Sermons now have a sleep timer, a queue, and downloads for listening without internet.
Voice messages, polls, announcement channels, search in a chat, and messages you can send later.
Press and hold your home screen, choose Widgets, and add the church widget: today\'s reading, the next event and the verse.
A light top card, colours chosen by the church, and Coming up for this week or this month on Home.

Choose what each member can do. A study contributor can add lessons, files, audio and reading plans. A leader can do what an owner can do in the app, for a term or with no end date. Only owners can make leaders.
Can add lessons, PDF files, audio, voice notes and reading plans.
Can do what an owner can do in the app, except give leader access.
Only an owner can make or change a leader.

One verse for each day, in Afaan Oromoo, Norsk and English, up to 366 days. The welcome card shows one a day in the person\'s language and starts again from day 1 after the last day. You only need the Afaan Oromoo (and Norsk) text: the English is found automatically each day. Copy the filled rows from the spreadsheet and paste them here, or add the days one at a time.
Copy the filled rows from the spreadsheet (from the Day column to the last column) and paste them here. The days you paste replace those days; the other days stay.
Could not import. Check the connection, and that you are a leader.
Add the first section with the plus button, for example Our history, What we believe, Our vision or Our leaders.
The story of our church will appear here soon.
Write your name and a phone number or an email address, then tap Send.
Open: everyone in the church is added automatically
Invite-only: only the people you pick can see it
